name.en-US: St. James of La Marca of Ancona
name.pt-BR: São Tiago de La Marca de Ancona

prayerExcerpt.en-US: He began his spiritual war against the devil, the world, and the flesh, with assiduous prayer and extraordinary fasts and watchings.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Começou sua guerra espiritual contra o demônio, o mundo e a carne, com oração assídua e extraordinários jejuns e vigílias.

meta.face: An Italian of the Marche of about seventy, gaunt, CLEAN-SHAVEN, with a sun-browned, weathered complexion and a LONG, RECTANGULAR face with deep vertical lines down the cheeks — a HIGH, broad, BALD crown with a thin ring of short grey hair; a LONG, heavy, straight nose with a BROAD, rounded tip; LARGE, round, dark eyes LIFTED upward under straight, dark-grey brows, the lower lids heavy; a WIDE, thin-lipped mouth slightly open as if about to preach; a LONG, broad chin; the gaze lifted and ardent. Not his master bernardine_siena (thin, pointed, sunken-cheeked), the small, triangular john_capistrano, the lantern-jawed patrician gregory_langres, the angular, moustached paschal_baylon, the smooth, narrow didacus or the craggy-browed peter_damian.
meta.basis: No portrait from life was found. The face follows Zurbarán's St. James of the Marches (English Wikipedia's lead: gaunt, long-faced, balding, eyes raised, chalice held up), which Crivelli's picture of 1477 (Italian Wikipedia, not seen) precedes; the chalice is his emblem, painted without the serpent that often escapes from it.
